newsitem.title: MOZAMBIQUE: U.N FOOD AGENCY OFFICIAL IN MOZAMBIQUE FOR TALKS.
newsitem.headline: U.N FOOD AGENCY OFFICIAL IN MOZAMBIQUE FOR TALKS.

text.p: The U.N. World Food Programme's assistant executive director Jean-Jacques Graisse arrived in Mozambique on Thursday for talks with the government, the organisation said on Friday.

A WFP statement said Graisse would meet senior government officials to discuss the WFP response to a government appeal last month for nearly $30 million in international aid to help victims of floods in Mozambique's central provinces.
He will also discuss future cooperation between Mozambique and the WFP in disaster management, rehabilitation of infrastructure, education and health.
Graisse is also scheduled to see for himself WFP-assisted programmes in the southern provinces of Maputo and Gaza including food-for-work projects and feeding schemes.
The WFP helped to ferry food and supplies to thousands of refugees affected by Mozambique's 16-year civil war which ended in 1992 with a peace accord between the Frelimo government and Renamo rebels.
